blacklistabilityReview.evidence: 2026-07-30 re-pin of freeze/transfer posture across all three tracked deployments. Ethereum 0x8c106eedad96553e64287a5a6839c3cc78afa3d0 is verified Morpho VaultV2 (immutable; EIP-1967 impl/admin slots zero at Ethereum block 25648243). VaultV2 transfer/transferFrom require canSendShares(sender) and canReceiveShares(recipient); canSendShares returns true when sendSharesGate==0 or the gate allows the account. At block 25648243: asset()=USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48, owner()=0xc684c6587712e5e7bdf9fd64415f23bd2b05faec, curator()=0x9e33faae38ff641094fa68c65c2ce600b3410585, sendSharesGate/receiveSharesGate/sendAssetsGate/receiveAssetsGate all zero, canSendShares(0x1)=true and canReceiveShares(0x2)=true, totalAssets≈84,287,391.52 USDC. Curator can submit a gate-setting call and execute after the vault's gate-setter timelock, so Ethereum direct transfer restriction is possible (not currently active). Base 0xee8f4ec5672f09119b96ab6fb59c27e1b7e44b61 (MetaMorpho) at Base block 49328092: asset=native Base USDC 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913, owner=0x5a4e19842e09000a582c20a4f524c26fb48dd4d0, EIP-1967 slots zero; ABI has no pause/blacklist/isBlacklisted and eth_call to those selectors reverts. Arbitrum 0x7c574174da4b2be3f705c6244b4bfa0815a8b3ed (MetaMorphoV1_1) at Arbitrum block 489415296: asset=native USDC 0xaf88d065e77c8cc2239327c5edb3a432268e5831, same owner, EIP-1967 slots zero; paused()/isBlacklisted eth_call reverts. Gauntlet branded-vault disclaimer states vaults are not custodial products and does not create holder freeze rights. Circle USDC remains additional upstream freezability on the underlying asset, not a gtUSDCp share blacklist. Aggregate direct posture: possible (Ethereum VaultV2 share gates).

mintAuthority.summary: gtUSDCp has three direct immutable Morpho vault deployments; shares mint only against each chain's USDC deposits. Ethereum and Base parameter owners are 4-of-7 Gauntlet Safes, while Arbitrum uses the same seven signers at a 3-of-7 threshold.

review.evidence: The full three-chain inventory was checked independently: Ethereum at block 25527215, Base at block 48599296, and Arbitrum at block 483587934. Every verified direct vault had zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots and returned the chain-local native USDC as asset(). Ethereum owner 0xc684c6587712e5e7bdf9fd64415f23bd2b05faec and Base owner 0x5a4e19842e09000a582c20a4f524c26fb48dd4d0 were 4-of-7 Safes; the same Arbitrum owner address was 3-of-7. All three had no modules or guard. Owners can curate vault parameters but cannot replace vault bytecode or mint base USDC. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: each immutable MetaMorpho deployment can mint shares only against deposited native USDC; the inherited base issuer publishes monthly Deloitte reserve examinations. The latest USDC report covers May 2026, and the NYDFS list matches Circle Internet Financial, LLC.

collateral: USDC deposited into a Gauntlet-curated MetaMorpho V2 vault on Morpho Blue; the curator allocates across permissioned USDC lending markets backed by blue-chip crypto and real-world asset collateral
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 MetaMorpho V2 vault shares appreciate against USDC as borrower interest accrues; withdrawals redeem vault shares for available USDC liquidity or wait for Morpho market liquidity to return
